failing_tests.name: Acl::~Acl() double-free during cleanup in test_acl

summary: Removed `deleted_zones.insert(it->zone);` from Acl::~Acl(). The `deleted_zones` set is declared and checked with `find()`, but never populated. If the same Zone* pointer appears in multiple AclEntry entries (e.g., two subnets sharing one zone), the first delete succeeds, the second encounters the same pointer but find() returns end() (set is empty), causing a double-free. test_acl passed all 7 individual assertions but then crashed with SIGSEGV (exit code 139) during Acl destructor cleanup, confirming the double-free. test_acl_longest_match and test_acl_query passed (they don't set up shared-Zone* scenarios that trigger the bug). The mutation is clearly killed and not equivalent.
